cohort: The study included all live neonates with <34 weeks gestational age admitted to 25 tertiary hospitals within 7 days of birth from 19 provinces in China.
finding: The incidence and case-fatality rate of necrotizing enterocolitis (NEC) are high among preterm infants in China, especially in those with gestational age >=32 weeks, with significant variation among sites and a high proportion requiring surgical management.
birth_weight: Varied, with NEC incidence decreasing with increasing birth weight
